interpretation: Training-only diagnostic: 128 fixed views for signals, first 32 for gradients. No parameters updated; no new decoder fits or validation/test access.

Visual response is current-eye rate minus neutral-gray-eye rate with the same context. Its centered variance is not an additive share of total variance; neutral combinations may be out of distribution.
Positive activity is a node-position fraction, not the count of motors that vary across the complete dataset. A zero derivative here does not mean a neuron is permanently dead.

The fitted raw-motor residual yields correct core cotangents through a fixed inverse readout-gain conversion. Its API readout-gain derivative belongs to that local surrogate, not the composite raw-residual objective; exclude it from scientific gradient comparisons.
All five native-versus-reference VJP comparisons are retained, including that auxiliary gain derivative. Task heads and gains are held fixed; core gradients and state cotangents are interpreted.
Raw single-objective gradients exclude joint-loss clipping and moment history. sqrt(vhat)/(sqrt(vhat)+epsilon) describes the saved Adam denominator, not an actual proposed update.
Path distances are truncated at seven hops; -1 is outside that horizon, not globally unreachable. A potential path ignores signs, cancellation and ReLU gates.
Incoming L2 and effective fan-in are descriptive. They imply variance transfer only under additional input-covariance assumptions. Row sums bound a local Jacobian, not long-horizon stability.
No causal optimizer/propagation effect, biological function, generalization gain, playing strength or matched-CNN benefit is established.
name: signal-flow-v2

plan.adjoint: FP64 analytical chain rule at native hard-rate state tapes, using independently reconstructed FP32 weights and leaks. Supply matching pooled cotangents through the existing native embedding VJP; compare all edge/type/input/readout-gain gradients before interpreting flow. This is a diagnostic, not a new learner implementation or update qualification.
plan.fitted_decoder: For trained cores only, use the already completed scaled-linear ridge-.01 residual from motor-convergence-v1. Its normalization, centering, coefficients and original-logit residual are unchanged. No fitted decoder is transferred to the initial core.
plan.name: signal-flow-v2

native_comparison.scope: Same elementwise gradient tolerances as existing CPU qualification; report every discrepancy, norm and relative L2 error. Preserve failures; do not change learner precision or tolerance to pass.

plan.reachability: Directed visual-sensor distance and reverse motor distance, truncated at K-1=7 synaptic hops. A visual-sensitive edge can lie on an allowed path only if d_eye(src)+1+d_motor(dst)<=7. Being on such a path is not proof of functional visual influence.
plan.revision: The v1 workers stopped at import before loading any data because PyArrow was absent. Read a lossless root-exported superclass column instead; mathematics, sources, sample, metrics and numerical comparisons unchanged. Preserve v1.
plan.scope: Read-only mechanism audit on three existing initial/trained cores and fixed training positions. No topology, input, propagation, parameters, optimizer or sampler changes. No new decoder fits, loss-based selection, final-test examples, playing-strength claims or TPU initialization. Measure signal transfer before registering a propagation intervention.
plan.selection: First 128 positions in the existing training bank, with its exact fixed D4 views; first 32 for cotangents. Same positions/orientations across seeds. No new sampling search or validation access.
plan.visual_probe: Native complete state tapes for actual current-board input and neutral gray eyes, holding the same 84 nonvisual context features fixed. Report absolute response and centered across-position variation; neutral context/image combinations can be out of distribution.
